summary: SoundThinking disclosed a definitive merger agreement dated September 28, 2026 with Transom Signal AcquireCo, an affiliate of Transom Capital Group, under which Merger Sub will launch a tender offer for all outstanding shares within 15 business days. Terms are $8.00 per share in cash plus one non-transferable CVR worth up to $3.00 upon milestone achievement. The board unanimously recommends the transaction and approved the CVR agreement. The tender remains open 20 business days, followed by a back-end merger. Watch milestone achievement risk on the CVR and any competing superior proposal before the offer closes.
